description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be what appears to be more aggression when it comes to age verification and ID laws. Canada and the US have been going harder when it comes to wanting our information across every service on the Internet and the only way left to fight back is to operate outside the mainstream and host everything on your own.
